borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission reference: 2010/01012/FUL dated 22nd September 2010 for the "Change of use of first and second floors from a General Office Use (Class B1) into four x 1 bedroom self contained flats, four x 2 bedroom self contained flats and one x 3 bedroom self contained flat; erection of a part one, part two and part three storey rear extension at first, second and third floor levels; erection of glass balustrade at roof level in connection with its use as a roof garden; erection of a single storey rear extension for use as bicycle storage space" to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include; Roof: Enlargement of the stairwell to align with lower floors; Third Floor: Updated internal layouts (no change to number of units or bedrooms), enlarged stairwell core, enlargement of both front and rear dormers to improve daylight, symmetry and overall design coherence with the facade, updated roof garden layout and provision of a defined mechanical plant area for future air source heat pumps; Second Floor: Updated internal layouts (no change to number of units or bedrooms), enlarged stairwell core, removal of the central atrium, western external wall adjusted outward by approximately 400mm to align with the floor below; First Floor: Updated internal flat layouts (no change to number of units or bedrooms), enlarged stairwell core, removal of the central atrium and addition of an external terrace for Flat 5; Ground Floor: Addition of a new entrance to the front elevation.
